content: Yesuji wain yo fuŋqoduine, noŋuŋ tieŋine fukegobeneŋ.
Yesuji kiŋariŋpuine oi iŋi yajiya, “Nonji wain yo foriine fukebe nonde Mamaji wain giore rau fukega.

Nonji yo oŋuine kiri tieŋneke fukego. Yo tieŋine sosowo foriyaŋuŋ so bofukeru aputa fukegobi, Mamaneji oi ketigaru boke yabeiŋ. Yo tieŋine sosowo nondeo ŋebi foriyaŋuŋ fukeru deegobi, Mamaneji oi ke keririke yabeiŋ. Eebobore foriine sogueru dekukuŋgaru boakoŋ fukenimiŋ ore boposike yabeiŋ.
“Ŋoŋo Biŋe buŋo ŋajibe oiji bofosike yaberu ke keririke yabeme gbagbataeŋine fukeru gogobi.

Ore eru ŋoŋoji noke qakatoru dimainebi. Oŋu dimabi nonji ŋoŋoke dimabemiŋ. Wain tieŋine moji yo botuineo so ŋeku mukuru wakiga ine, oi iŋoyoŋe maŋgo ee eku foriine fukeiŋgo embimbiŋgaiŋ. Ore so ŋoŋoji oŋuakoŋ noke so qakatoru dimagobi ine, ŋoŋo-ŋaŋe akoŋ eebobore fori mo bofukenimiŋgo embimbiŋganimiŋ.

“Noŋ wain yo fukekabe ŋoŋoji ore tieŋine fukegobi. Ŋoŋo boke nuru ŋoŋo-ŋaŋe akoŋ dimaku ya mo baniminde embiŋbimganimiŋ. Ore eru moji noke qakatoru dimako nonji iŋoke qakatoru dimabe iŋoji eebobore fori mokemoke yobu bofukeru goiŋ.
Uri yoŋoji noke so qakatoru dimagobi ine, wain yo rauineji oi yo tieŋ oŋuine keti yaberu bokeme sakibe ranimiŋ. Raru qaŋibi roru qodureru misigo bokeme rakaru janimiŋ.
“Yoŋoji janimiŋyoŋ, aribe ŋoŋo noke qakatoru dimainebi. Oŋu dimabi nonde Biŋe buŋoji ŋoŋore maŋgo qakatoru dimaga ine, ŋoŋoji oi me oi biŋe qoqo ekiminde manegobi, oi Mama oŋga wosi tebi ŋareiŋ.
Ŋoŋoji nonde kiŋariŋpu fukeru dimakabi eeboboŋaŋunde fori mokemoke yobu fukeru wakiru ŋekabi gonimiŋ. Oŋu eba eku gonimiŋ ore Mamanere tinaji kuririineke fukeru peiŋ.
Mamaneji noŋ manji jojoko enareku goya, nonji ore so oŋuakoŋ manji jojoko eyareru goboŋ. Ŋoŋo nonde manjoko maŋgo dimainebi.
Nonji Mamanere mimipaŋ buŋo reŋgaru go waperu iŋore manjoko maŋgo dimago. Ore so ŋoŋo nonde mimipaŋ buŋo roru reŋgaru gonimiŋ ine, soine nonde manjoko maŋgo dimakabi manjoko eyareru gobemiŋ.
“Nonji maŋ jeri ŋarebe petigaru maŋ-ŋaŋuŋ puseru peko mokemoke yobu jerieru gonimiŋ ore buŋo oi ŋajibe manegobi.
Nonde Kadi buŋo oi iŋi: Nonji maŋneji manjoko eŋareru gobe, ŋoŋo ore so ŋoŋo-ŋaŋe jojoko eku goinebi.
Moji ogopuine yoŋore eru iŋoyoŋunde gogo kisiŋgaru bokeiŋ, oiji manjoko ropekiine sogo fukega. Moji oi odureru manjoko eŋareiŋgo embimbiŋgaiŋ. Manji jojoko goine oi ore wawakiine.
“Nonji ya enimiŋ ore mitiga ŋareego, ŋoŋoji ore so eegobi ine, nonde ogopu fukegobi.

Kiŋaŋqoqore fuŋne iŋi: Siŋaŋineji gioine uruŋu eru baega, oi kiŋaŋqoqoineji so maneega. Ore eru ŋoŋore tina ‘Kiŋaŋqoqopune,’ oŋu so jikigaru miŋarebemiŋyoŋ, Mamaneone Biŋe buŋo maneboŋ, oi sosowo ŋoŋore barariŋga ŋarebe manegobi. Ore eru tinaŋaŋuŋ ‘Ogopune,’ oŋu oŋga ŋarebe sagaga.

“O ogopune, ŋoŋoji noŋ so roosoe nubuŋyoŋ, nonji ŋoŋo roosoeru igodoŋ ŋabebe dimagobi. Ore eru ŋoŋoji roregaru raru foriine iŋi bofukeru damaŋ so dekabi pe ropeko sagaiŋ: Nonde tina oŋgaku ya oi me oi ore Mama oŋga wosinimiŋ, oi ŋareme biŋeŋaŋuŋ fukeiŋ.
Ŋoŋo botuŋaŋuŋgo jojoko eku goinebi. Nonji mimipaŋ buŋone oŋu mitari yarego.” Oŋu.
Maŋkekerisiere qopu yoŋo ŋoŋo rosi eŋarenimiŋ.
“Moreŋgo maŋyaŋuŋ so kerisiebi yoŋo rosi eŋarenimiŋ ine, ŋoŋo buŋo iŋi mane mukuinebi: Yoŋoji rone noŋ oŋuakoŋ rosi enareku gobuŋ.

Ŋoŋo maŋkekerisiere yaura kubuo gonimiŋ ine, kubupuyaŋuŋ yoŋoji yoŋoyaŋunde ogopu maŋyauŋ eyarenobuŋ. Oi eyarenobuŋyoŋ, nonji ŋoŋo roosoeru yoŋore buruone oga ŋabebe furuine fukeru gogobi. Yoŋore eebobo sembene oi ŋadi gaku gogobi ore eru rosi eŋareegobi.

“Nonji buŋo mo iŋi ŋajibe manebuŋ, oi maŋ wombuŋ-ŋaŋuŋgo ruaru manesuinebi, ‘Kiŋaŋqoqoji wakiqoqoine fukeko rauineji soguneine fukega. Kiŋarinji qaqajiine odureru ropekiine fukeiŋgo embimbiŋgaiŋ.’ Ore so goineji noŋ kekesuesue enareku go wapebuŋ ine, goine yoŋoji nonde igokopu ŋoŋo oŋuakoŋ kekesuesue eyareku gonimiŋ. Yoŋoji nonde Biŋe buŋo maneru sabareku gobuŋ ine, ŋoŋoji nonde buŋo misaueku gobi oŋuakoŋ soine maneru sabareru gonimiŋ.
Oŋu gonimiŋyoŋ, noŋ sore nuya, yoŋoji oi so mane mukubi. Ore eru keoma paio ya fuŋne fuŋne kosa eŋarenimiŋ, oi nonde tinabiŋere eru fuke ŋareiŋ.

“Nonji yoŋoreo so wakiru Biŋe buŋo yajibe manenimiŋ ine, yoŋoji agiburaŋyaŋunde mimi so maneru gonimiŋ. Oŋu mo gonimiŋyoŋ, damaŋ yoo agiburaŋyaŋuŋ mane foreru kefaganimiŋ ore embimbiŋganimiŋ. Gbegbedi buŋoyaŋuŋ uruŋu bofukenobuŋ?
Moji noŋ rosi enarega, iŋoji Mamane oŋuakoŋ rosi etega.

Mosi qoqowirie ropekiine sogo babe, oi moji mo ŋoŋore botugo so baku goya. Nonji oi so banobo ine, yoŋoji agiburaŋyaŋunde mimi oi so maneru gonobuŋ. Koŋkoŋ qaku gonobuŋyoŋ, damaŋ yoo nonji oi babe ŋone foreru jibu noŋ eru Mamane oŋuakoŋ omaine yobu rosi enoteku gogobi.
“Oŋu enoteku gobi Biŋe buŋo moji foriineke fukeya. Mosesji kadi buŋo ŋareya, oo buŋo oi iŋi quraŋgame pega, ‘Yoŋoji omaine yobu rosi enareku gobuŋ.’ Buŋo oiji foriineke fukeya.

“Nonji Mamareo roperu uje Rauine sorebe ŋoŋore wareru maŋ-ŋaŋuŋgo rakaru kitiŋ ŋabeiŋ. Moro Tiriine iŋoji buŋo foriinere Rau fukega. Iŋoji Mamaone wakiru nonde fuŋnene kitiŋgaku mitaniŋga yareru goiŋ.

Iŋoji oŋu goiŋ eru ŋoŋoji oŋuakoŋ nonde fuŋne kitiŋgaku mitaniŋgaru gonimiŋ. Nonji fuŋgaru mande tumoqoqo gio ba gobe, ŋoŋoji fuŋfuŋgaineone noke goku pakerebuŋ. Ore eru ŋoŋo oi soine mitaniŋgaru goinebi. Oŋu.”
